description: 3 positives (1 de) + 2 near-misses + 1 counterexample. The near-misses are the two neighbours whose vocabulary overlaps most: a component-architecture question that mentions Tailwind but is about composition, and a design decision that is about which colour to pick rather than how to express it in utilities. The counterexample is unrelated backend work, guarding the over-trigger on the bare word 'style'.
